description: List the picks' tags, most-used first, with counts and each tag's slug: the tag list_picks filters on, and what a collection's rule names. Returns the top 50 unless limit says otherwise; query keeps the tags whose name or slug contains it. meta.total_count is how many tags matched, and page reads on past the first limit of them. Subscribers only: sign in through this server's OAuth.

page.description: The next limit of tags, so the whole list can be read.

query.description: Part of a tag's name or slug, any case: "capital", "100m".

name: list_tags
title: List tags
